constraints: You must call DOM CLOSE XML on the returned reference when finished, to free the in-memory XML tree.
root may be prefixed with a namespace name followed by ':' (e.g. "MyNameSpace:MyRoot"); when it is, the nameSpace parameter (the namespace value) becomes mandatory.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Creates a new, empty in-memory XML tree with the given root element name (and optional namespace declarations), returning its root reference.

jointConstraints.rule: If root is prefixed with 'namespaceName:', nameSpace (declaring that namespace's value) must also be passed.
